description: This Java class 'Billing' represents a data model for billing information in an e-commerce system. It defines fields for personal and address details, including relationships to country and zone entities, with appropriate JPA annotations.

classes.name: Billing
classes.description: Data model class for storing billing address and contact details, embeddable in other entities.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the billing address.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company name associated with the billing address.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the street address for billing.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the street address for billing.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city of the billing address.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city for billing.

methods.name: getPostalCode
methods.description: Returns the postal code of the billing address.

methods.name: setPostalCode
methods.description: Sets the postal code for billing.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Retrieves the country entity associated with billing.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Associates a country entity with billing.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the zone associated with billing.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Associates a zone entity with billing.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the state/region of billing.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state/region for billing.

methods.name: getTelephone
methods.description: Retrieves the telephone number associated with billing.

methods.name: setTelephone
methods.description: Sets the telephone number for billing.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the last name of the billing contact.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name of the billing contact.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the first name of the billing contact.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name of the billing contact.
